title: Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Crag
description: Geldis Sadri mentions a pack of werewolves in the mountains. Travel to Frostmoon Crag to meet the Frostmoon Pack and, if you carry the beast blood, earn their trust and gain access to Majni's unique rings.

base_facts: I run The Retching Netch cornerclub in Raven Rock.
I keep my ear to the ground for interesting rumors around Solstheim.

HEAR_RUMOR_FROM_GELDIS: I told the traveler about the hunters up at Frostmoon Crag.

base_facts: I am a member of the Frostmoon Pack.
I guard our camp at Frostmoon Crag from outsiders.

ARRIVE_AT_FROSTMOON_CRAG: I confronted a stranger approaching our camp.
WEREWOLF_RECOGNIZED: I sensed the beast blood in this traveler. They are one of us.

base_facts: I am the Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack.
I offer unique rings to fellow werewolves who respect our law.

TALK_TO_MAJNI: I welcomed a fellow werewolf to the Frostmoon Pack, telling them they are welcome here so long as they respect our law.
I now offer four unique rings that affect the wearer's beast form for sale.
I will only speak with and sell my rings to those who carry the beast blood; if their lycanthropy is cured, I will refuse them.

beats.comment: Player hears about the hunters at Frostmoon Crag from Geldis Sadri, starting the quest.
Player arrives at Frostmoon Crag and is confronted by Rakel.
Rakel senses the beast blood in the player and welcomes them as kin.
Player talks to Majni, Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack, completing the quest.
